# SPD2010 display driver

Unmodified Espressif Apache-2.0 driver files from Waveshare's
[ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-1.46 repository](https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-1.46),
revision `fda89ff2ff32eb1bce561901225c6a36fa684237`.

Source directory:
`example/ESP-IDF-5.3.2/ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-1.46-Test/main/LCD_Driver/esp_lcd_spd2010`.
Original SPDX notices are retained; see [Apache-2.0](../LICENSE).
